content.query: let t = traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'INGEST ' | parse message with 'INGEST status=' status ' engine=' engine ' ms=' ms:long ' blob=' blob; let submitted = t | where status == 'submitted' | distinct blob; let doneBatch = t | where status == 'transcribed' and engine == 'batch' | distinct blob; let inprog = toscalar(submitted | join kind=leftanti doneBatch on blob | count); let terminal = t | where status in ('transcribed','failed','quarantined'); union (terminal | summarize Value = countif(status == 'transcribed') | extend Metric = 'Transcribed'), (terminal | summarize Value = countif(status == 'failed') | extend Metric = 'Failed'), (terminal | summarize Value = countif(status == 'quarantined') | extend Metric = 'Quarantined'), (print Metric = 'In progress', Value = inprog) | extend o = case(Metric == 'Transcribed', 1, Metric == 'Failed', 2, Metric == 'Quarantined', 3, 4) | order by o asc | project Metric, Value
content.title: Last 24 hours

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'INGEST ' | parse message with 'INGEST status=' status ' engine=' engine ' ms=' ms:long ' blob=' blob | where status in ('transcribed','failed','quarantined') | summarize Files = count() by status, bin(timestamp, 1h) | order by timestamp asc
content.title: Throughput per hour (terminal outcomes)

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'INGEST ' | parse message with 'INGEST status=' status ' engine=' engine ' ms=' ms:long ' blob=' blob | where status == 'transcribed' | summarize Files = count() by engine
content.title: Transcribed by engine

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'INGEST ' | parse message with 'INGEST status=' status ' engine=' engine ' ms=' ms:long ' blob=' blob | where status == 'transcribed' and ms > 0 | summarize Files = count(), p50_sec = round(percentile(ms, 50) / 1000.0, 1), p95_sec = round(percentile(ms, 95) / 1000.0, 1) by engine | order by Files desc
content.title: Latency by engine (seconds)

content.query: requests | where timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize Executions = count(), Failed = countif(success == false), p95_ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by name | order by Executions desc
content.title: Function health (infrastructure - transient retries are normal)

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'INGEST status=failed' | parse message with 'INGEST status=' status ' engine=' engine ' ms=' ms:long ' blob=' blob | project timestamp, engine, blob | order by timestamp desc | take 50
content.title: Recent failures

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(24h) and message startswith 'Quarantined ' | parse message with 'Quarantined ' blob ' (' reason ')' | project timestamp, blob, reason | order by timestamp desc | take 50
content.title: Recent quarantines (with reason)

content.query: traces | where timestamp > ago(1h) | where message startswith 'INGEST ' or message startswith 'Processing ' or message startswith 'Transcript ' or message startswith 'Batch ' or message startswith 'Quarantined ' or severityLevel >= 2 | project timestamp, severityLevel, message | order by timestamp desc | take 200
content.title: Live activity (last hour)
